symptom: ako/mxcli#1939 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1735): Microflows$SendExternalObject and Microflows$DeleteExternalObject had no MDL. A flow that saves an external (OData) object could not be written (a plain commit on an external entity is a Studio Pro error), describe printed `-- Unsupported action: Microflows$SendExternalObject`, and the drop + create rebuild that MDL-V1-REBUILD recommends deleted the send silently — check passed, exec printed no warning.
cause: No statement, AST node, builder, writer, reader case or describe spelling existed; the reader returned an UnknownAction, which describe prints as a comment and a rebuild therefore omits.
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4 (externalObjectStatement: (SEND | DELETE) EXTERNAL OBJECT VARIABLE REFRESH? onErrorClause?), mdl/ast (ExternalObjectStmt), sdk/microflows (SendExternalObjectAction, DeleteExternalObjectAction), mdl/backend/modelsdk microflow_write.go / microflow_read_actions.go, mdl/executor builder + every statement switch rollback appears in (graph, validate, flows refs, control error handling, loop scope, rule validation, mermaid, elk, exprcheck StatementErrorHandling), validate_microflow_error_handling.go (MDL076 for continue), cmd/mxcli/syntax odata.write
insight: Rollback has exactly this shape (variable, refresh in client, error handling), so 'grep every switch rollback appears in' is the checklist — the builder test passed while the flow builder's dispatch still did not know the statement, because it called the builder function directly. Measured on 11.12.6 with one microflow per project copy (a shared project's CE list does not say which flow each error is in): Continue is CE6035 on both actions; the default (Rollback) and custom handlers with or without rollback are accepted; a delete on a set the $metadata does not mark deletable is CE9435. The written BSON drew no structural error from mx check, and drop + create from describe output keeps the send (descriptions equal, 0 errors). A rebuilt mxcli binary is needed before an end-to-end check run — a stale one passed the continue case. Not covered: the generic hazard that any other UnknownAction is still lost by a drop + create. Studio Pro reference afterwards: ako/TestApp 31a34ca, Odata.ODataSendDeleteMF (Studio Pro 11.16) — both activities store exactly ErrorHandlingType ("Rollback" with no handler, unlike a plain delete, which stores none), the variable and RefreshInClient; mxcli's writer produces that property set and those values (only the key order differs, which BSON does not care about), the reader describes the Studio Pro unit as `send external object $NewOrders;` / `delete external object $NewOrders;`, and drop + create from that description gives the same two activities. The write test fails with the 'omit when empty' default a plain delete uses — the guess this reference settled.
